test: survive a server restart in the middle of a live relay session

setup.viewer: tools/lab/a2a/resume-check.cjs (raw /screen?binary=1, same path as the dashboard)

phases.note: the agent reconnected inside the 120s boot grace, so relayResumeForDevice moved it back to active on its own

before_31112.behaviour: relaySessions lived in a Map only; a restart answered session_not_active and the viewer could not reopen

guarantees.write_through: requested, accepted/active, suspended, resumed, denied, expired, closed -> one UPSERT per transition
guarantees.pending_offers: requested/accepted rows are dropped on boot (nobody is waiting for them)
guarantees.close_path: relayCloseSession persists closed, then the 5-minute prune deletes the row (audit_log keeps history)
